overall.assessment: Podcast pokazuje visoku razinu usklađenosti s kršćanskom antropologijom prepoznajući dostojanstvo osobe, važnost ranjivosti i potrebu za autentičnim susretom. Naglasak na 'skidanju maski' i duhovnom vodstvu odražava biblijski poziv na istinu o sebi pred Bogom, dok kolektivna podrška i validacija patnje odgovaraju pozivu na solidarnost i brigu za bližnjega. Iako se fokusira na specifične ženske izazove, pristup je utemeljen na univerzalnoj potrebi za cjelovitim ozdravljenjem u zajednici, što je u skladu s crkvenim naukom o čovjeku kao biću stvorenom za zajedništvo.
seeds_of_logos: Prepoznavanje dostojanstva žene kao osobe stvorene na sliku Božju
Promicanje kulture susreta kroz iskrenu komunikaciju i slušanje
Naglasak na važnosti duhovnog vodstva i oslanjanja na Božju milost
Solidarnost u patnji kao put prema ozdravljenju i zajedništvu
Poticanje na autentičnost i istinu o sebi kao preduvjet za duhovni rast
overall.theological_context: Tematika se oslanja na kršćansku antropologiju izraženu u KKC 369 i 1934, koja potvrđuje jednako dostojanstvo muškarca i žene. Dokumenti poput 'Mulieris Dignitatem' sv. Ivana Pavla II. i 'Fratelli Tutti' pape Franje pružaju okvir za razumijevanje ženskog poziva i važnosti solidarnosti u suvremenom društvu, dok 'Gaudium et Spes' (14-15) naglašava važnost ulaska u vlastito srce radi susreta s Bogom.

sections.subtitle: Posebna epizoda: Marko o ženskim unutarnjim borbama i putu do autentičnosti
sections.screenshot_description: Voditeljica i Marko sjede u uredu, s kavom, spremni za razgovor.
sections.content: U posebnoj epizodi podcasta 'Osnažene', voditeljica je ugostila Marka u njegovom uredu, najavljujući 'limited edition' razgovor. Istaknula je Markovu dugogodišnju ekspertizu u radu sa ženama, naglašavajući da je on osoba s najviše iskustva u toj domeni. Voditeljica je podijelila kako joj Markovi savjeti i učenja svakodnevno pomažu u osobnom životu i odnosu s Bogom. Marko je izrazio zadovoljstvo što može sudjelovati u epizodi, vjerujući da će biti korisna ne samo ženama, već i 'osnaženim muškarcima' koji prate podcast. Tema razgovora fokusirana je na ženske unutarnje borbe, društvena očekivanja i put do autentičnosti kroz podršku i duhovni rad.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom, naglašavajući važnost duhovnog rada i podrške, no zahtijeva oprez u pogledu autoriteta pojedinaca.
concerns: Potencijalno pretjerano oslanjanje na 'ekspertizu' pojedinca umjesto na crkveno vodstvo ili sakramentalni život.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče duhovno vodstvo i pratnju, ali naglašava da je pravi učitelj duhovnog života Duh Sveti, a ne isključivo ljudska ekspertiza (KKC 2681, 2672).
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is mostly aligned with Catholic teaching, emphasizing the importance of spiritual work and support, but requires caution regarding the authority of individuals.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages spiritual direction and accompaniment, but emphasizes that the true teacher of the spiritual life is the Holy Spirit, and not exclusively human expertise (CCC 2681, 2672).
concerns_en: Potentially excessive reliance on the 'expertise' of an individual instead of on church leadership or sacramental life.

sections.subtitle_en: Special episode: Marko on women's inner struggles and the path to authenticity
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host and Marko are sitting in the office, with coffee, ready for the conversation.
sections.content_en: In a special episode of the podcast 'Osnažene', the host hosted Marko in his office, announcing a 'limited edition' conversation. She highlighted Marko's long-standing expertise in working with women, emphasizing that he is the person with the most experience in that domain. The host shared how Marko's advice and teachings help her daily in her personal life and relationship with God. Marko expressed satisfaction that he can participate in the episode, believing that it will be useful not only to women, but also to 'empowered men' who follow the podcast. The theme of the conversation is focused on women's inner struggles, societal expectations, and the path to authenticity through support and spiritual work.

sections.subtitle: Zašto žene prednjače u radu na sebi i duhovnom vodstvu?
sections.screenshot_description: Marko objašnjava zašto su žene aktivnije u duhovnim pokretima.
sections.content: Voditeljica je Marka upitala zašto su žene, u usporedbi s muškarcima, sklonije radu na sebi i traženju duhovnog vodstva. Marko je odgovorio citirajući propovjednika koji je ustvrdio da čak sedamdeset posto današnjih duhovnih pokreta vode žene. Dodatno, Marko je spomenuo biblijski kontekst, konkretno Petrovu poslanicu, koja sugerira da su molitve muškaraca blokirane ako su im žene nezadovoljne. S druge strane, žene nemaju takvu blokadu, što, prema Marku, olakšava duhovni proboj s njima. Voditeljica je nadopunila, ističući kako pozitivna promjena kod žene u obitelji često lakše potakne muškarca na vjeru i obraćenje, nego obrnuto.

magisterium.assessment: Djelomično usklađeno; tumačenje 1. Petrove poslanice o 'blokiranim molitvama' zbog nezadovoljstva supruga je teološki pojednostavljeno i potencijalno izvan konteksta.
concerns: Izvlačenje biblijskih stihova iz konteksta (1 Pt 3,7) radi opravdavanja suvremenih socioloških teza o duhovnosti.
Generalizacija o 'blokiranim molitvama' može stvoriti nepotreban strah ili krivnju.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveto pismo (1 Pt 3,7) poziva muževe na poštovanje prema ženama kao 'slabijem spolu' (u smislu fizičke krhkosti ili društvene ranjivosti tog vremena) kako molitve ne bi bile zapriječene, što je poziv na uzajamnu ljubav, a ne mehanizam uvjetovanja (KKC 369, 1603).
magisterium.assessment_en: Partially aligned; the interpretation of the 1st Epistle of Peter about 'blocked prayers' due to the dissatisfaction of the husband is theologically simplified and potentially out of context.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Sacred Scripture (1 Pt 3:7) calls husbands to respect toward wives as the 'weaker sex' (in the sense of physical frailty or social vulnerability of that time) so that prayers would not be hindered, which is a call to mutual love, and not a mechanism of conditioning (CCC 369, 1603).
concerns_en: Taking biblical verses out of context (1 Pt 3:7) to justify contemporary sociological theses about spirituality.
Generalization about 'blocked prayers' can create unnecessary fear or guilt.

sections.subtitle_en: Why do women lead in working on themselves and spiritual direction?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko explains why women are more active in spiritual movements.
sections.content_en: The host asked Marko why women, in comparison to men, are more prone to working on themselves and seeking spiritual direction. Marko answered by quoting a preacher who asserted that as many as seventy percent of today's spiritual movements are led by women. Additionally, Marko mentioned the biblical context, specifically Peter's epistle, which suggests that the prayers of men are blocked if their wives are dissatisfied. On the other hand, women do not have such a block, which, according to Marko, makes a spiritual breakthrough easier with them. The host added, pointing out how a positive change in a woman in the family often more easily prompts a man to faith and conversion than vice versa.

sections.subtitle: Tereti i očekivanja: Nevidljive borbe suvremene žene
sections.screenshot_description: Marko gestikulira dok govori o teretima koje žene nose.
sections.content: U razgovoru o najčešćim patnjama i težinama koje žene nose, Marko je istaknuo da se mnoge bore s **teretima i očekivanjima**, posebno u katoličkim krugovima, gdje postoji pritisak da se dostignu određeni ideali. Često se osjećaju 'u rasulu' ili im je život 'u rasulu', ali se boje o tome govoriti, maskirajući svoje probleme. Posebno je naglasio borbe majki s djecom koja možda ne slijede njihov put, što im donosi veliku bol. Marko je istaknuo potrebu za dopuštenjem da se osjećaju 'ok' čak i kada su 'loše' ili 'slomljene', kritizirajući savjete poput 'trebaš više moliti' koji samo pojačavaju osjećaj krivnje. Naglasio je da Isusov pristup nije opterećen zakonom, već nudi milost i razumijevanje.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s kršćanskim razumijevanjem ljudske patnje i potrebe za autentičnošću pred Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska tradicija prepoznaje važnost 'skidanja maski' pred Bogom u molitvi, gdje se vjernik predaje Gospodinu u istini i poniznosti (KKC 2702, 2717).
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with the Christian understanding of human suffering and the need for authenticity before God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian tradition recognizes the importance of 'taking off masks' before God in prayer, where the believer surrenders to the Lord in truth and humility (CCC 2702, 2717).

sections.subtitle_en: Burdens and expectations: Invisible struggles of the contemporary woman
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko gesticulates while speaking about the burdens that women carry.
sections.content_en: In the conversation about the most common sufferings and difficulties that women carry, Marko pointed out that many struggle with **burdens and expectations**, especially in Catholic circles, where there is pressure to reach certain ideals. They often feel 'in shambles' or their life is 'in shambles', but they are afraid to speak about it, masking their problems. He especially emphasized the struggles of mothers with children who perhaps do not follow their path, which brings them great pain. Marko pointed out the need for permission to feel 'ok' even when they are 'bad' or 'broken', criticizing advice like 'you need to pray more' which only increase the feeling of guilt. He emphasized that Jesus' approach is not burdened by the law, but offers grace and understanding.

sections.subtitle: Potreba za tišinom: Ženski vapaj za unutarnjim mirom
sections.screenshot_description: Voditeljica zamišljeno govori o potrebi za tišinom.
sections.content: Voditeljica je podijelila svoje osobno iskustvo preplavljenosti i potrebe za tišinom, čak i tijekom klanjanja, gdje joj je jedina želja 'samo biti'. Istaknula je da je tišina najčešći odgovor žena kada ih se pita što im je najpotrebnije. Marko je potvrdio ovu potrebu, objašnjavajući da je buka, pogotovo u obiteljima s djecom, konstantna. Nedostatak vremena za sebe i mir dovodi do frustracije i 'pucanja' kod roditelja. Marko je opisao kako se osjeća nemoćno kada je preopterećen, a djeca traže pažnju, što rezultira iskaljivanjem. Zaključio je da je pronalaženje vremena za tišinu danas veliki izazov.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s katoličkim naukom o važnosti tišine i sabranosti za duhovni život.
magisterium.enrichment: Tišina je 'simbol svijeta koji dolazi' i nužna je za kontemplativnu molitvu, gdje se srce sabire u Božjoj prisutnosti (KKC 2717, 2702).
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of silence and recollection for the spiritual life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Silence is the 'symbol of the world to come' and is necessary for contemplative prayer, where the heart gathers in God's presence (CCC 2717, 2702).

sections.subtitle_en: The need for silence: A woman's cry for inner peace
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host thoughtfully speaks about the need for silence.
sections.content_en: The host shared her personal experience of being overwhelmed and the need for silence, even during Eucharistic adoration, where her only desire is 'just to be'. She pointed out that silence is the most common answer of women when they are asked what they need most. Marko confirmed this need, explaining that noise, especially in families with children, is constant. The lack of time for oneself and peace leads to frustration and 'snapping' in parents. Marko described how he feels helpless when he is overloaded and the children demand attention, which results in lashing out. He concluded that finding time for silence is a great challenge today.

sections.subtitle: Tijelo pamti: Fizičke manifestacije stresa i preopterećenosti
sections.screenshot_description: Marko opisuje fizičke simptome stresa, možda držeći ruku na ramenu.
sections.content: Voditeljica je opisala kako se njezin živčani sustav teško smiruje, čak i u opuštajućim situacijama, zbog kronične preopterećenosti. Spomenula je vježbu tišine gdje su sudionici deset minuta tišine doživjeli kao pola sata, što ukazuje na naviku tijela na konstantnu aktivnost. Marko je potvrdio ove fizičke manifestacije stresa, opisujući svoje iskustvo nakon napornog putovanja: nesanicu, stiskanje mišića i zuba, te osjećaj grča u tijelu. Tek nakon povratka kući, njegovo se tijelo počelo opuštati. Naglasio je kako unutarnje provlačenje informacija i stresa utječe na fizičko stanje, dovodeći do ozljeda i opće iscrpljenosti.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer prepoznaje važnost brige za zdravlje i prepoznaje fizičke posljedice stresa.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naglašava da je tijelo dar Božji o kojem se treba razumno brinuti (KKC 2288). Sveto pismo također upozorava na štetnost pretjerane tjeskobe i važnost odmora (Sir 31,19-20; 30,21-24).
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is mostly aligned with Catholic teaching because it recognizes the importance of care for health and recognizes the physical consequences of stress.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church emphasizes that the body is a gift of God which should be reasonably cared for (CCC 2288). Sacred Scripture also warns of the harmfulness of excessive anxiety and the importance of rest (Sir 31:19-20; 30:21-24).

sections.subtitle_en: The body remembers: Physical manifestations of stress and overload
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko describes physical symptoms of stress, maybe holding a hand on the shoulder.
sections.content_en: The host described how her nervous system calms down with difficulty, even in relaxing situations, due to chronic overload. She mentioned a silence exercise where the participants experienced ten minutes of silence as half an hour, which indicates the body's habit of constant activity. Marko confirmed these physical manifestations of stress, describing his experience after an exhausting journey: insomnia, clenching of muscles and teeth, and a feeling of spasm in the body. Only after returning home did his body begin to relax. He emphasized how the internal dragging through of information and stress affects the physical state, leading to injuries and general exhaustion.

sections.subtitle: Olakšanje kroz definiciju: Moć validacije problema
sections.screenshot_description: Marko priča o iznenađujućim reakcijama na validaciju problema.
sections.content: Na pitanje voditeljice što ga je najviše iznenadilo u radu sa ženama, Marko je istaknuo **moć definiranja problema**. Primijetio je da ljudi doživljavaju ogromno olakšanje i oslobođenje kada im se problem validira i imenuje. Kao primjer naveo je ženu koja je godinama mislila da joj nedostaje vjere, da bi tek nakon čitanja njegove objave o anksioznosti shvatila da se zapravo bori s anksioznošću. Marko je podijelio i osobno iskustvo kada je bio nervozan bez jasnog razloga, da bi kasnije shvatio da je to bio strah izazvan jednom informacijom. Zaključio je da samo definiranje problema može donijeti nevjerojatnu promjenu i osjećaj 'napokon dišem', što je često snažnije od bilo kakvog savjeta.

magisterium.assessment: Validacija i imenovanje problema mogu biti korisni alati za samosvijest, što je u skladu s kršćanskom brigom za osobu.
magisterium.enrichment: Važno je da se psihološka validacija nadopunjuje duhovnim vodstvom, kako bi se razlikovala klinička stanja od duhovnih potreba. Kršćanska nada nudi dublji smisao i utjehu iznad same psihološke definicije (KKC 1509).
magisterium.assessment_en: Validation and naming of problems can be useful tools for self-awareness, which is in accordance with Christian care for the person.
magisterium.enrichment_en: It is important that psychological validation is complemented by spiritual direction, in order to distinguish clinical conditions from spiritual needs. Christian hope offers a deeper meaning and consolation beyond the psychological definition itself (CCC 1509).

sections.subtitle_en: Relief through definition: The power of problem validation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko talks about surprising reactions to the validation of the problem.
sections.content_en: To the host's question about what surprised him the most in working with women, Marko highlighted **the power of defining the problem**. He noticed that people experience immense relief and liberation when their problem is validated and named. As an example, he mentioned a woman who for years thought she lacked faith, only to realize only after reading his post about anxiety that she was actually struggling with anxiety. Marko also shared a personal experience when he was nervous without a clear reason, only to realize later that it was fear caused by a single piece of information. He concluded that the mere definition of the problem can bring an incredible change and a feeling of 'finally I'm breathing', which is often stronger than any advice.

sections.subtitle: Očekivanja od žena: Nekad i danas – nejednaki tereti
sections.screenshot_description: Marko uspoređuje uloge muškaraca i žena u prošlosti i sadašnjosti.
sections.content: Marko je povukao paralelu između društvenih očekivanja od žena nekada i danas. Istaknuo je kako je nekadašnja podjela uloga (muškarac radi, žena je kod kuće) danas nerealna. Naglasio je da, iako oba partnera često rade, očekivanja ostaju nejednaka: neuredan dom se i dalje pripisuje ženi, dok se financijski problemi pripisuju muškarcu. Marko je argumentirao da su današnja očekivanja čak i veća zbog visokih troškova života koji zahtijevaju da oba partnera rade. Podijelio je i osobno iskustvo, rekavši da je svjesno tražio ambicioznu partnericu koja gradi karijeru, te da je to njihov zajednički izbor. Zaključio je da je važno preuzeti odgovornost za vlastite izbore, bilo da se radi o skromnijem životu ili žrtvovanju za više.

magisterium.assessment: Analiza društvenih očekivanja i nejednakih tereta u skladu je s crkvenim naukom o dostojanstvu žena i muškaraca te važnosti uzajamnosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk promiče jednako dostojanstvo muškaraca i žena, uz naglasak na komplementarnosti i uzajamnom darivanju (Familiaris Consortio 22; Papa Franjo, 2015). Društvo treba podržavati obitelj i olakšati usklađivanje obiteljskih i profesionalnih obveza (Papa Ivan Pavao II., 1995).
magisterium.assessment_en: Analysis of societal expectations and unequal burdens is in accordance with Church teaching on the dignity of women and men and the importance of reciprocity.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching promotes the equal dignity of men and women, with an emphasis on complementarity and mutual giving (Familiaris Consortio 22; Pope Francis, 2015). Society should support the family and facilitate the harmonization of family and professional obligations (Pope John Paul II, 1995).

sections.subtitle_en: Expectations of women: Once and today – unequal burdens
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko compares the roles of men and women in the past and the present.
sections.content_en: Marko drew a parallel between social expectations of women in the past and today. He pointed out how the former division of roles (man works, woman is at home) is unrealistic today. He emphasized that, although both partners often work, expectations remain unequal: an untidy home is still attributed to the woman, while financial problems are attributed to the man. Marko argued that today's expectations are even greater due to the high costs of living which require both partners to work. He also shared a personal experience, saying that he consciously sought an ambitious partner who is building a career, and that this is their joint choice. He concluded that it is important to take responsibility for one's own choices, whether it is about a more modest life or sacrificing for more.

sections.subtitle: Kolektivna podrška: Ključ za osnaživanje žena danas
sections.screenshot_description: Marko govori o važnosti podrške u zajednici.
sections.content: Voditeljica je primijetila kako su žene u prošlosti imale snažniju zajedničku podršku, posebno u razdobljima poput postpartuma, gdje su se obitelj i susjedi brinuli o majci i djetetu. Upitala je Marka što društvo danas može učiniti kako bi kolektivno pomoglo ženama. Marko je naglasio **važnost podržavajućeg okruženja** i sustava podrške. Kritizirao je mentalitet 'ja sam to prošla, pa ćeš i ti', koji sprječava pružanje pomoći. Podsjetio je na prošla vremena kada su djecu čuvale bake ili susjedi, što je danas gotovo nezamislivo. Marko je istaknuo potrebu za **proaktivnom pomoći**, ne čekajući da netko zatraži, već nudeći podršku. Spomenuo je anegdotu o prikupljanju sredstava gdje se 70% donacija dobije tek nakon direktnog upita, što ukazuje na opću pasivnost u pružanju pomoći. Pozvao je na promjenu tog stava, potičući ljude da budu prvi koji će ponuditi 'Tu sam, javi se'.

magisterium.assessment: Promicanje kolektivne podrške i zajedništva snažno je usklađeno s kršćanskim načelom solidarnosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Solidarnost je kršćanska krepost koja nas poziva na brigu za bližnjega, posebno za najranjivije (KKC 1948; Libertatis conscientia 89). Crkva potiče stvaranje sustava podrške koji odražavaju brigu za opće dobro i dostojanstvo svake osobe.
magisterium.assessment_en: Promoting collective support and togetherness is strongly aligned with the Christian principle of solidarity.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Solidarity is a Christian virtue which calls us to care for our neighbor, especially for the most vulnerable (CCC 1948; Libertatis conscientia 89). The Church encourages the creation of support systems which reflect care for the common good and the dignity of every person.

sections.subtitle_en: Collective support: Key for empowering women today
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko speaks about the importance of support in the community.
sections.content_en: The host noticed how women in the past had stronger collective support, especially in periods like postpartum, where family and neighbors cared for the mother and child. She asked Marko what society today can do to collectively help women. Marko emphasized the **importance of a supportive environment** and support systems. He criticized the mentality 'I went through that, so you will too', which prevents the provision of help. He recalled past times when grandmothers or neighbors watched children, which is almost unimaginable today. Marko highlighted the need for **proactive help**, not waiting for someone to ask, but offering support. He mentioned an anecdote about fundraising where 70% of donations are received only after a direct inquiry, which points to a general passivity in providing help. He called for a change in that attitude, encouraging people to be the first to offer 'I am here, reach out'.

sections.subtitle: Moć viđenosti i saslušanosti: Bezuvjetna podrška u patnji
sections.screenshot_description: Marko priča o iskustvu s osobom koja se osjećala saslušanom.
sections.content: Voditeljica je istaknula koliko je ženama važno osjećati se **viđenima i saslušanima**, dijeleći iskustva žena koje su joj pisale da se dugo nisu osjećale saslušanima. Marko je kritizirao površne utjehe poput 'bit će dobro' ili 'misli pozitivno', uspoređujući ih s pokušajem tješenja Isusa na križnom putu. Takvi komentari, objasnio je, mogu dovesti do osjećaja da Bog ne voli osobu ili da ona ne moli ispravno. Podijelio je snažnu anegdotu o osobi s teškom životnom situacijom koju su drugi odbili saslušati. Marko, iako nije imao konkretno rješenje, ponudio je razumijevanje i molitvu, što je osobu dovelo do suza zahvalnosti i osjećaja prihvaćenosti. Zaključio je da je ponekad najbolja pomoć jednostavno biti prisutan i suosjećati, čak i ako to znači plakati s osobom, dopuštajući joj da osjeti svoje emocije bez osude.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj ispravno naglašava važnost suosjećanja i 'viđenosti' u patnji, što je u potpunosti u skladu s kršćanskim pozivom na solidarnost i utjehu bližnjega.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska antropologija naglašava da se čovjek ne može potpuno pronaći osim kroz iskreni dar sebe, a suosjećanje s patnikom odraz je Božje ljubavi koja nas poziva da ne prolazimo mimo onih koji pate (usp. Salvifici Doloris, 28).
magisterium.assessment_en: The content correctly emphasizes the importance of compassion and 'being seen' in suffering, which is completely in accordance with the Christian call to solidarity and the comfort of one's neighbor.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian anthropology emphasizes that man cannot fully find himself except through a sincere gift of self, and compassion for the sufferer is a reflection of God's love which invites us not to pass by those who suffer (cf. Salvifici Doloris, 28).

sections.subtitle_en: The power of being seen and heard: Unconditional support in suffering
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko talks about an experience with a person who felt listened to.
sections.content_en: The host highlighted how important it is for women to feel **seen and heard**, sharing the experiences of women who wrote to her that they had not felt heard for a long time. Marko criticized superficial consolations like 'it will be fine' or 'think positively', comparing them to an attempt to console Jesus on the Way of the Cross. Such comments, he explained, can lead to the feeling that God does not love the person or that she does not pray correctly. He shared a powerful anecdote about a person with a difficult life situation whom others refused to listen to. Marko, although he did not have a concrete solution, offered understanding and prayer, which led the person to tears of gratitude and a feeling of acceptance. He concluded that sometimes the best help is simply to be present and empathize, even if it means crying with the person, allowing her to feel her emotions without judgment.

sections.subtitle: Skidanje maski: Put do ranjivosti i autentičnosti
sections.screenshot_description: Marko objašnjava koncept maski i ranjivosti, možda s ozbiljnim izrazom lica.
sections.content: Voditeljica je povezala temu podrške s konceptom 'maski' i autentičnosti, pitajući kako pomoći ženama čiji je unutarnji svijet u rasulu, dok izvana djeluju savršeno. Marko je dodao da je bliskim osobama teže pružiti bezuvjetnu podršku jer se osjećamo dijelom problema. O maskama je objasnio da one proizlaze iz straha od ranjivosti, povrede ili ismijavanja. Kao ilustraciju je naveo lik iz crtića 'Minecraft' – svinju koja je, nakon što je bila ismijana zbog svoje kreativnosti, postala okrutna. Maske su, dakle, obrambeni mehanizmi za prihvaćanje. Marko je podijelio i osobno iskustvo kritike audio podcasta od strane kolegice, što je doživio kao test svoje unutarnje sigurnosti. Zaključio je da se **istinsko prihvaćanje** događa tek kada smo autentični, a ne kada nosimo masku. Spomenuo je i kako nas odgoj (npr. 'djevojčice se ne glupiraju', 'dečki ne plaču') uči potiskivanju emocija i stvaranju maski, koje najčešće skidamo kod kuće, gdje se osjećamo najsigurnije.

magisterium.assessment: Tema 'skidanja maski' i autentičnosti dobro je povezana s kršćanskim konceptom poniznosti i istine o sebi pred Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Autentičnost u kršćanskom smislu nije samo psihološka kategorija, već duhovna stvarnost u kojoj se osoba, oslobođena straha, otvara Božjoj milosti i istini o vlastitoj krhkosti (usp. Sensus fidei, 101).
magisterium.assessment_en: The theme of 'taking off masks' and authenticity is well connected with the Christian concept of humility and the truth about oneself before God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Authenticity in the Christian sense is not only a psychological category, but a spiritual reality in which a person, freed from fear, opens themselves to God's grace and the truth about their own fragility (cf. Sensus fidei, 101).

sections.subtitle_en: Removing masks: The path to vulnerability and authenticity
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko explains the concept of masks and vulnerability, perhaps with a serious facial expression.
sections.content_en: The host connected the theme of support with the concept of 'masks' and authenticity, asking how to help women whose inner world is in disarray, while on the outside they appear perfect. Marko added that it is harder to provide unconditional support to close persons because we feel like part of the problem. Regarding masks, he explained that they stem from the fear of vulnerability, hurt, or ridicule. As an illustration, he cited a character from the cartoon 'Minecraft' – a pig that, after being ridiculed for its creativity, became cruel. Masks are, therefore, defense mechanisms for acceptance. Marko also shared a personal experience of criticism of an audio podcast by a female colleague, which he experienced as a test of his inner security. He concluded that **true acceptance** happens only when we are authentic, and not when we wear a mask. He also mentioned how upbringing (e.g., 'girls do not goof around', 'boys do not cry') teaches us the suppression of emotions and the creation of masks, which we most often take off at home, where we feel safest.

sections.subtitle: Izazov skidanja maski i važnost samosvijesti
sections.screenshot_description: Voditeljica govori o poteškoćama skidanja maski i važnosti samosvijesti.
sections.content: Voditeljica je potvrdila da je i sama, kada nije osjećala potpuno razumijevanje, stavljala maske, ne želeći opteretiti druge. Naglasila je koliko je teško skinuti te duboko ukorijenjene maske. Podijelila je iskustvo anketiranja žena na trgu s pitanjem: 'Tko si ti kad te nitko ne gleda, kad makneš sve svoje uloge?' Mnoge su se borile s odgovorom ili su tvrdile da ne nose maske, što ukazuje na nedostatak samosvijesti. Voditeljica je istaknula da ne postoji osoba koja ne nosi maske, jer se prilagođavamo svijetu. Naglasila je moć i hrabrost priznavanja te borbe i traženja odgovora. Podijelila je i osobno iskustvo: kada je donosila odluke usklađene s Božjom voljom, mogla se nositi s poteškoćama, dok su je odluke donesene radi udovoljavanja drugima lako poljuljale.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na samosvijesti i prepoznavanju vlastitih uloga je koristan, iako zahtijeva oprez da se ne pretvori u puki introspektivni psihologizam.
concerns: Potreban je oprez da se 'skidanje maski' ne svede na čisto psihološku vježbu bez usmjerenosti prema Bogu i sakramentalnom životu.
magisterium.enrichment: Samosvijest je tek prvi korak; kršćanska duhovnost nas poziva da tu spoznaju usmjerimo prema Bogu, jer se čovjek može istinski upoznati samo u svjetlu Kristove ljubavi (usp. Redemptor hominis, 10).
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on self-awareness and recognizing one's own roles is useful, although it requires caution so that it does not turn into mere introspective psychologism.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Self-awareness is only the first step; Christian spirituality calls us to direct that knowledge toward God, because man can truly know himself only in the light of Christ's love (cf. Redemptor hominis, 10).
concerns_en: Caution is needed so that 'taking off of masks' is not reduced to a purely psychological exercise without orientation towards God and sacramental life.

sections.subtitle_en: The challenge of removing masks and the importance of self-awareness
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host talks about the difficulties of taking off masks and the importance of self-awareness.
sections.content_en: The host confirmed that she herself, when she did not feel complete understanding, put on masks, not wanting to burden others. She emphasized how difficult it is to take off those deeply rooted masks. She shared the experience of surveying women on the square with the question: 'Who are you when no one is watching you, when you remove all your roles?' Many struggled with the answer or claimed that they do not wear masks, which indicates a lack of self-awareness. The host pointed out that there is no person who does not wear masks, because we adapt to the world. She emphasized the power and courage of admitting that struggle and searching for answers. She also shared a personal experience: when she made decisions aligned with God's will, she could cope with difficulties, while decisions made to please others easily shook her.

sections.subtitle: Otkrivanje unutarnjih istina: Dopustiti Bogu da nas vodi
sections.screenshot_description: Marko govori o otkrivanju sebe kroz životna iskustva i Božju pomoć.
sections.content: Marko je proširio pitanje 'Tko si ti kad te nitko ne gleda?' na dublje unutarnje istine kojih možda nismo ni svjesni. Podijelio je osobna iskustva otkrivanja novih aspekata sebe kroz brak i roditeljstvo, ističući kako se 'otvorio jedan dio mene koji je izazvao neke nove stvari'. Sugerirao je da je puno lakše i nježnije dopustiti Bogu da nam otkriva stanje našeg srca i što želi obnoviti, umjesto da čekamo da nas drugi 'ubodu' u naše rane. Iako je suočavanje s potisnutim emocijama bolan put, Marko je naglasio da je to neophodno kako bismo osjetili puninu dobrih osjećaja i emocija, jer dok su nam neke stvari zabranjene, ne možemo u potpunosti živjeti.

magisterium.assessment: Prijedlog da se Bogu dopusti vodstvo u otkrivanju unutarnjih istina duboko je ukorijenjen u kršćanskoj duhovnosti i praksi razlučivanja.
magisterium.enrichment: Razlučivanje zahtijeva strpljivo traženje Boga u svakodnevici, gdje se kroz molitvu i sakramente otkriva istina o nama samima, oslobođena od iluzija i 'autopilota' (usp. Papa Franjo, Kateheza o razlučivanju, 2022).
magisterium.assessment_en: The proposal to allow God guidance in discovering inner truths is deeply rooted in Christian spirituality and the practice of discernment.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Discernment requires patient seeking of God in everyday life, where through prayer and sacraments the truth about ourselves is revealed, freed from illusions and 'autopilot' (cf. Pope Francis, Catechesis on discernment, 2022).

sections.subtitle_en: Discovering inner truths: Allowing God to lead us
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marko speaks about discovering oneself through life experiences and God's help.
sections.content_en: Marko expanded the question 'Who are you when no one is watching you?' to deeper inner truths of which we might not even be aware. He shared personal experiences of discovering new aspects of himself through marriage and parenthood, emphasizing how 'a part of me opened up that provoked some new things'. He suggested that it is much easier and gentler to allow God to reveal to us the state of our heart and what He wants to renew, instead of waiting for others to 'poke' us in our wounds. Although facing suppressed emotions is a painful path, Marko emphasized that it is necessary in order for us to feel the fullness of good feelings and emotions, because while some things are forbidden to us, we cannot fully live.

sections.subtitle: Ženska konferencija: Putovanje ka susretu sa samom sobom
sections.screenshot_description: Voditeljica najavljuje žensku konferenciju s Markom.
sections.content: Voditeljica je najavila nadolazeću žensku konferenciju, ističući da će biti potpuno drugačija od dosadašnjih. Inspirirana trogodišnjim intenzivnim tim-buildingom s Markom, koji uključuje vježbe, meditacije i duhovne obnove, voditeljica je poželjela da i druge žene dožive duboke uvide i susret s Bogom bez osude. Cilj konferencije je omogućiti ženama da 'skinu sve svoje maske', pronađu podršku, tišinu i kontakt sa samima sobom, te da odu s konkretnom promjenom ili uvidom. Marko će biti glavni voditelj, vodeći sudionice kroz vježbe, molitvu i evanđeoske meditacije. Broj mjesta je ograničen kako bi se osigurao dublji i personaliziraniji rad. Marko je izrazio uzbuđenje zbog koncepta 'Tko si ti kad nitko ne gleda?', naglašavajući praktični rad i individualnu spremnost za dubinu iskustva. Pozvao je žene da se prijave na 'Susret sa samom sobom'.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer promiče duhovni rast, samospoznaju u svjetlu vjere i zajedništvo, što su legitimni ciljevi kršćanskog života.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk naglašava da se čovjekova istinska samospoznaja postiže u svjetlu Krista, koji 'objavljuje čovjeka samom čovjeku' (GS 22). Važno je da 'susret sa sobom' ne postane introspekcija radi nje same, već put prema dubljem zajedništvu s Bogom i bližnjima, prepoznajući vlastito dostojanstvo kao stvorenja na sliku Božju.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is mostly aligned with Catholic teaching because it promotes spiritual growth, self-knowledge in the light of faith, and communion, which are legitimate goals of Christian life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching emphasizes that man's true self-knowledge is achieved in the light of Christ, who 'reveals man to man himself' (GS 22). It is important that the 'encounter with oneself' does not become introspection for its own sake, but a path toward deeper communion with God and neighbors, recognizing one's own dignity as a creature in the image of God.

sections.subtitle_en: Women's Conference: Journey Towards an Encounter with Oneself
sections.screenshot_description_en: The female host announces the women's conference with Marko.
sections.content_en: The host announced the upcoming women's conference, emphasizing that it will be completely different from the previous ones. Inspired by a three-year intensive team-building with Marko, which includes exercises, meditations, and spiritual retreats, the host wished for other women to also experience deep insights and an encounter with God without judgment. The goal of the conference is to enable women to 'take off all their masks', find support, silence, and contact with themselves, and to leave with a concrete change or insight. Marko will be the main leader, leading the participants through exercises, prayer, and Gospel meditations. The number of places is limited in order to ensure deeper and more personalized work. Marko expressed excitement about the concept 'Who are you when no one is watching?', emphasizing practical work and individual readiness for the depth of the experience. He invited women to register for 'Encounter with oneself'.

iterations.theme_en: Women's inner struggles, societal expectations and the path to authenticity through support and spiritual work
